summary: Phase 1 Glassmorphism follow-up (gradient background + fixed orbs) visually + computationally verified on design/glassmorphism-phase1 branch. All 9 requested items pass. Gradient `linear-gradient(135deg, #EFF6FF 0%, #F8FAFC 50%, #EFF6FF 100%)` with `background-attachment: fixed` is applied via `.app-bg-gradient` on the MainLayout root. Two fixed orbs are rendered behind all content with exact spec values: Orb1 fixed top:-100px right:-100px 500x500 rgba(37,99,235,0.08) blur(80px) z-index:0; Orb2 fixed bottom:-100px left:-100px 400x400 rgba(37,99,235,0.06) blur(80px) z-index:0. Main content wrapper has `position:relative; z-index:1` so it sits above orbs, and the Header stays `position:fixed; z-index:50` above everything. Login page (AuthLayout) correctly does NOT have gradient or orbs. Scroll test confirmed orbs stay in place (position:fixed). Mobile 390px viewport renders gradient + orbs + hamburger correctly.

scroll_fixed_test.result: PASS - orbs remain fixed as user scrolls

pages_tested./: PASS - gradient + 2 orbs render, blue orb1 top-right subtly visible, orb2 bottom-left visible, glass nav with blue SwiftTickets logo sticky at top above content
pages_tested./howitworks: PASS - gradient clearly visible on right/left gutters, orbs present, Safe/Easy/Fair glass cards show stronger glass effect against gradient
pages_tested./howtosell: PASS - gradient + orbs visible, 4 step cards visible with glass effect, blue 'Got tickets to sell?' CTA preserved
pages_tested./about: PASS - gradient background clearly visible, glass nav readable, orbs behind content
pages_tested./events: PASS - glass nav with dark readable text over hero banner, gradient visible below hero, orbs present
pages_tested./auth/login: PASS - unchanged AuthLayout (no gradient, no orbs) — dark translucent login card preserved as expected
pages_tested.scroll_behavior: PASS - orbs stay in place while content scrolls above them (verified via bounding rect comparison before/after 1500px scroll)
pages_tested.mobile_390px: PASS - gradient wrapper present, orb1 (500x500) and orb2 (400x400) still render, hamburger visible; note: on 390px viewport orb1 (starting at right:-100) extends across most of the top creating a nice blue glow, orb2 at bottom-left still offset

critical_code_review_comments: Implementation matches spec exactly. The `.app-bg-gradient main .bg-\[\#F4F4F4\]` override is correctly scoped to descendants of main so Sheet/modal portals outside main stay opaque — good defensive scoping.
`pointer-events: none` set on both orbs prevents any click interception — correct.
Both orbs use vendor-prefixed `-webkit-filter: blur(80px)` alongside standard `filter` — good Safari compatibility.
Consider adding `will-change: transform` or `transform: translateZ(0)` on orbs if performance jank is observed during scroll on low-end devices — not required for Phase 1 but noted for future.

Unrelated pre-existing issues NOT caused by this change: (a) several React DOM warnings about kebab-case SVG props (stroke-width, clip-path, fill-rule, etc.) — should be camelCased; (b) nested <a> inside <a> hydration error on HomePage Banner → LinkWithRef inside LinkWithRef; (c) several React Query functions returning undefined causing 'Something went wrong' on /events Sports/Concerts sections. These are out of scope for this review.
